newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Helix rockets on Gawler Craton find.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Helix rockets on Gawler Craton find.

text.p: The shares of gold hopeful, Helix Resources NL nearly doubled in price on Monday after the company reported promising drilling results from its Lake Everard gold project in the Gawler Craton of South Australia.
At 2.40 p.m. (0340 GMT), Helix shares were 43 cents, or 96 percent, higher at 88 cents on volume of about four million shares.

In an earlier announcement to the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX), Helix said it had received preliminary results from two lines of drilling at the project with significant intersections including 36 metres at 4.4 grams per tonne (g/t) gold and 112 metres at 1.0 g/t gold.

"The drilling results demonstrate the extraordinary size of gold mineralised drilled intervals which the newly discovered Yarlbrinda shear zone of the Gawler Craton can produce," the company said in its statement.
Helix owns 100 percent of the Lake Everard project.
Last week, Helix was one of the best performing stocks in the Eyres Reed Explorers index, its shares moving up eight cents to 45 cents.
Helix said it was sufficiently encouraged by the early results to implement further and more detailed exploration activities at the project.
